candidates.title: Alicja Kwade: Waiting Pavilions
candidates.blurb: Kwade's sculptural pavilions in a former colonial prison yard: phenomenology meets adaptive reuse.

candidates.title: Ancient Egypt Unveiled: Treasures from Egyptian Museums
candidates.blurb: Egyptian state museums lend directly to Hong Kong, bypassing Western intermediaries for once.

candidates.title: Treasures of Global Jewellery from The Metropolitan Museum of Art: The Body Transformed
candidates.blurb: The Met's global jewellery holdings shown where half the world's luxury jewellery is actually bought.

candidates.title: Joyful Encounters: The Connoisseurship and Art of Wong Kwan Shut
candidates.blurb: Mid-century Hong Kong collector-painter who navigated Shanghai diaspora networks; rare institutional focus on local connoisseurship.

candidates.title: A History of China in Silk: The Chris Hall Collection at the Hong Kong Palace Museum
candidates.blurb: British collector's silk textiles shown in a Beijing-backed museum: the cultural entanglements are the exhibition.

candidates.title: Fermata: Hong Kong in Venice
candidates.blurb: Hong Kong's Venice Biennale collateral event shown locally: rare chance to see what the city commissioned for export.

candidates.title: Live: Hong Kong Art Exhibition
candidates.blurb: Government museum's biennial survey of local contemporary practice; bellwether for what institutional Hong Kong considers safe.

candidates.title: Proudly from Canton: The Muwen Tang Collection of Cantonese and Export Art
candidates.blurb: Export porcelain and Canton School paintings: the material history of how 'Chinese' aesthetics were packaged for global trade.

candidates.title: The Hong Jockey Club Series: A Day in the City — An Experimental Study of Things Across Time
candidates.blurb: Palace Museum collection reframed through urban daily life; ambitious attempt at social history through imperial objects.

candidates.title: Heavenly Horses: Masterpieces from the Palace Museum
candidates.blurb: Imperial equestrian art spanning dynasties; horses as proxy for power, speed, and Silk Road exchange.

candidates.title: The Ways in Patterns: An Immersive Digital Exhibition from the Palace Museum
candidates.blurb: Digital interpretation of Forbidden City decorative motifs; watch how institutions digitize imperial semiotics.
